args.trend_paragraph: Nuvve Holding Corp. (NVVE) topped the NASDAQ on July 8, 2026, rocketing 63.58% to close at $8.49, up from a prior close of $5.19. The five-day picture is turbulent rather than a steady climb: the stock fell 9.57%, 10.86% and 15.10% on three consecutive sessions, then bounced 6.13% before the explosive final-day surge. Across the five days it gained 18.81% overall, beating the S&P 500 by 18.99 percentage points, with an average daily move of 6.84%. Annualised volatility is an extraordinary 519.55%, and the stock suffered a maximum drawdown of 31.57% along the way, so the pattern is best described as mixed.
